notes:
The calibration fixture. The agent's stated posture is 'Bias toward Warning when in doubt' and 'do not invent a Warning to look thorough', and this spec gives it several near-miss opportunities: acceptance criteria whose negative cases are phrased as positive assertions, an explicit `Open Questions: None` rather than an omitted section, a `Card` used with a documented default-override, and switch dimensions (36x20px) that are off the spacing scale. A Warning on any of them is a false positive; zero Blockers AND zero Warnings is the pass.

FIXTURE v1. The first baseline run of this eval scored this fixture 56.7% over three runs, and two of the three findings were CORRECT: the digest picker's four option labels were visible text with no Copy Index row, and the States column read `all` on rows the loading-state prose replaces with a skeleton. Both were real defects in the fixture, not reviewer false positives, so the fixture was corrected and the eval re-baselined rather than the score being recorded against a control that was not clean. The pre-correction measurement is kept in CLOSEOUT-BASELINE.md.
